small, deterministic HTTP API for D&D 5e style helpers.\nIt runs on OpenJDK with only the Java standard library and uses an external `sqlite3` binary for persistence.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nPORT=8080 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` compiles the Java sources under `dnd/` and runs `dnd.Main` in the foreground.\nThe server listens on `127.0.0.1` and honors the `PORT` environment variable (default `8080`).\n\nVerify it is up:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n# -> {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nStop the server with `Ctrl-C`.\n\n## Entry point and major files\n\n```\ndnd/\n  Main.java                 # entry point: opens the HTTP socket and wires the router\n  handlers/\n    RequestRouter.java      # all HTTP handler methods and route registration\n  server/\n    HttpSupport.java        # read request bodies, send JSON responses\n  game/\n    Rules.java              # dice, XP, encounter difficulty, ability modifiers, etc.\n  json/\n    JsonParser.java         # minimal recursive-descent JSON parser\n    JsonUtils.java          # JSON serialization and int coercion\n  model/\n    Combatant.java          # initiative combatant\n    CombatSession.java      # persisted encounter\n    Condition.java          # status condition on a combatant\n    User.java               # registered user with salt/hash\n  storage/\n    Storage.java            # SQLite-backed persistence layer\n```\n\n`run.sh` compiles everything with `javac -d .` and then runs `java dnd.Main`.\n\n## State, persistence, and routing design\n\n### Persistence\n\nAll durable state lives in `game.db`, a SQLite database.\n`Storage` shells out to the `sqlite3` binary for each query and wraps every public method with a single `synchronized` lock, because each query is an independent process.\nThe schema is created lazily by `Storage.init()` and recreated by `Storage.reset()`.\n\nTables:\n- `users` — registered accounts with PBKDF2 hash and salt.\n- `combat_sessions`, `combatants`, `conditions` — initiative and condition tracking.\n- `monsters`, `monster_tags` — monster compendium.\n- `items` — item compendium.\n- `campaigns`, `campaign_characters`, The built-in `JsonParser` and `JsonUtils` are intentionally minimal and preserve the exact output format expected by the test suite:\n\n- Field order is determined by `LinkedHashMap` insertion For an active campaign, the queue is built by alternating each party member (in the deterministic party order) with the DM — for example, a two-player party yields `[\"player-a\",\"dm\",\"player-b\",\"dm\"]`. FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = \" + quote(id) + \";\");\n            if (sessionRows.isEmpty()) return null;\n            Map<String, Object> sessionRow = sessionRows.get(0);\n\n            List<Combatant> combatants = new ArrayList<>();\n            List<Map<String, Object>> combatantRows = query(\"SELECT name, score, dex, roll FROM combatants WHERE session_id = \" + quote(id) + \" ORDER BY sort_order;\");\n            for (Map<String, Object> row : combatantRows) {\n                combatants.add(new Combatant((String) row.get(\"name\"), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"score\")), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"dex\")), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"roll\"))));\n            }\n\n            CombatSession session = new CombatSession((String) sessionRow.get(\"id\"), combatants);\n            session.round = JsonUtils.toInt(sessionRow.get(\"round\"));\n            session.turnIndex = JsonUtils.toInt(sessionRow.get(\"turn_index\"));\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> conditionRows = query(\"SELECT target, condition, remaining_rounds FROM conditions WHERE session_id = \" + quote(id) + \" ORDER BY id;\");\n            for (Map<String, Object> row : conditionRows) {\n                String target = (String) row.get(\"target\");\n                session.conditions.computeIfAbsent(target, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(new Condition((String) row.get(\"condition\"), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"remaining_rounds\"))));\n            }\n\n            return session;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public void addCondition(String sessionId, String target, String condition, int IOException {\n        String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();\n        String prefix = \"/v1/play/campaigns/\";\n        if (!path.startsWith(prefix)) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 404, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Not found\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        String rest = path.substring(prefix.length());\n        int slash = rest.indexOf('/');\n        if (slash < 0) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 404, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Not found\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        String campaignId = rest.substring(0, slash);\n        String action = rest.substring(slash + 1);\n        if (\"members\".equals(action)) {\n            handlePlayCampaignJoin(exchange, campaignId);\n            return;\n        }\n        if (\"start\".equals(action)) {\n            handlePlayCampaignStart(exchange, campaignId);\n            return;\n        }\n        if (\"narrations\".equals(action)) {\n            handlePlayCampaignNarration(exchange, campaignId);\n            return;\n        }\n        if (\"actions\".equals(action)) {\n            handlePlayCampaignActionSubmit(exchange, campaignId);\n            return;\n        }\n        if (\"resolutions\".equals(action)) {\n            handlePlayCampaignResolution(exchange, campaignId);\n            return;\n        }\n        if (\"turn\".equals(action)) {\n            if (\"GET\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n                handlePlayCampaignTurn(exchange, campaignId);\n                return;\n            }\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        if (action.startsWith(\"turn/\")) {\n            String turnAction = action.substring(\"turn/\".length());\n            if (\"nudge\".equals(turnAction)) {\n                if (\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n                    handlePlayCampaignNudge(exchange, campaignId);\n                    return;\n                }\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n                return;\n            }\n        }\n        if (\"my-turn\".equals(action)) {\n            if (\"GET\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n                handlePlayCampaignMyTurn(exchange, campaignId);\n                return;\n            }\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        if (\"gm/status\".equals(action)) {\n            if (\"GET\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n                handlePlayCampaignGmStatus(exchange, campaignId);\n                return;\n            }\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 404, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Not found\\\"}\");\n    }\n\n    private void handlePlayCampaignTurn(HttpExchange exchange, String campaignId) throws IOException {\n        User user = authenticate(exchange);\n        if (user == null) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 401, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Unauthorized\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        Map<String, Object> campaign = storage.getPlayCampaignTurn(campaignId);\n        if (campaign == null) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 404, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Campaign not queue.add(owner);\n            }\n        }\n        res.put(\"current_actor\", currentActor);\n        String phase;\n        if (\"lobby\".equals(status)) {\n            phase = \"lobby\";\n    res.put(\"logical_deadline\", deadline == null ? 1 : JsonUtils.toInt(deadline));\n        res.put(\"overdue\", false);\n        res.put(\"queue\", queue);\n        HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n    }\n\n    private void handlePlayCampaignMyTurn(HttpExchange exchange, String campaignId) throws IOException {\n        User user =
